name: cache-references
meaning: Kernel generic cache references; cache level, prefetch and request scope are CPU/kernel dependent.

name: cache-misses
meaning: Kernel generic cache misses; not guaranteed to be demand-load or LLC misses.

name: l1d_cache_refill_rd
meaning: L1D line allocations caused by speculative load misses.

name: ll_cache_rd
meaning: Last-level read event; EXTLLC/firmware dependent. Existing 8.3 results did NOT validate SLC boundary.

name: ll_cache_miss_rd
meaning: Last-level read miss event; existing 8.3 results track L2 refills, NOT verified SLC misses.

name: dTLB-load-misses
meaning: Kernel data-TLB read-miss mapping; may mean page walks rather than L1 TLB misses.
